exposure: Maternal COVID-19 vaccination status (unvaccinated, partially vaccinated, completely vaccinated, booster vaccinated)
Timing of maternal COVID-19 vaccination before birth
outcome: Severe perinatal morbidity and mortality index
Referral to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: The study enrolled 4707 neonates born to 1577 mothers diagnosed with COVID-19 and 3130 nondiagnosed mothers.
finding: Neonates of booster-vaccinated mothers had significantly reduced risks for COVID-19 diagnosis, preterm birth, and respiratory distress syndrome, whereas newborns of unvaccinated mothers had double the risk for neonatal death.
